title: Reports
help: Explore gym activity, membership and revenue. Each chart has a data table and CSV download.
noAccess: You do not have permission to view reports.
rangeHelp: Choose up to 24 months, ending with this month or earlier. If your browser shows a text box, enter months as YYYY-MM, such as 2026-01. Dates use {timezone}. Counts for the current period can still change.
rangeError: Choose a valid range of 1 to 24 months in the form YYYY-MM, ending no later than the current month.
emptyHelp: There are no results for this selection. Choose another range or program.
chartHelp: The data table immediately below gives every period and value. Negative bars extend below zero.
attendanceHelp: All programs shows totals followed by program rows. Unique members are counted separately in each row; do not add them across programs. Weekly boundary periods can be partial.
membersHelp: New and imported members are counted separately. Churn is the share of members active at the start of the month who cancel that month. N/A means nobody was active at the start. A member is counted as frozen only when all their current memberships are frozen. Counts for the current period can still change.
revenueHelp: Payments count in the month they were paid, and refunds in the month they succeeded. A reversed refund is subtracted in the month it was reversed. Tax appears separately and is included in totals. Discounts are negative. Amounts use the currency shown; different currencies are kept separate.
zeroHelp: All counts are zero for this selection. The chart and table include each period.
